summary: Leclerc edges Verstappen in opening practice as Ferrari hunts momentum against Red Bull's championship favorite heading into Austin. Antonelli approaches the U.S. Grand Prix on the brink of clinching the world title, but treacherous track conditions—Verstappen calling the bumps "unacceptable"—threaten to scramble the weekend's pecking order. A victory here solidifies Antonelli's maiden championship or gives Verstappen a critical lifeline to keep the title fight alive.
